neighbours.label: ' in' after a superlative, naming the place it is the most in ('the largest X in the world')
fire: It is the tallest waterfall in the world.
Lagos has the largest market in Africa.
This is the deepest lake in the country.
She runs the oldest bakery in Europe.
It remains the busiest airport in the world.
They built the longest bridge in the world.
Tokyo has the biggest fish market in Asia.
The reef is home to the rarest corals in the world.
quiet: It is a pretty waterfall in the hills.
Lagos has a large market in the centre.
This is a quiet lake in the country.
She runs a small bakery in Europe.
It remains a busy airport in the north.
They built a long bridge in the south.
Tokyo has a big fish market in the bay.
The reef is home to rare corals in the warm water.

notes: The opposite pole fires on ' in'/' to' after 'unique', 'only', 'peculiar'. Probes: superlatives with a domain rather than a place ('best record in baseball', 'oldest member in the team') did not fire.
